topic: Buying a Used Car from a Lot

script.title: CHECKING OUT A USED CAR
script.scene_zh: 二手車場 · 試開看車況
script.story_hook: A buyer checks a used car before paying anything.
script.intro_zh: 買家看車、試開，先確認車況再做決定。
script.welcome_en: Hi everyone, welcome back! Today we're buying a used car.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，各位，歡迎回來！今天我們來買二手車。
script.outro: That's one careful car test! Listen again and repeat.
script.outro_zh: 這趟看車真仔細！再聽一次，跟著唸。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's say these car shopping lines together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 一起來唸這些買車會用到的句子。

script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚗買二手車英文｜問里程・試開車・購買前要檢查｜聽完就會看車｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
看中一台二手車，要用英文問什麼？
里程、事故紀錄、儀表板的燈，怎麼開口？
覺得不對勁，該怎麼談價格？

這一集帶大家走進二手車場的停車場，跟著買家從問里程與紀錄、要求試開，到發現煞車偏軟與指示燈亮起，最後約好購買前檢查，全程都是自然的日常美式英語。

你會聽到：
🔢 問車況基本資料：例如「What's the mileage?」、「Has it been in any accidents?」。
🚗 試開與找問題：例如「Can we take it for a drive?」、「the brakes feel a bit soft.」。
💰 談價格與檢查：例如「that changes the price for me.」、「I'd like my own mechanic to check it.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把看車時的對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次去看二手車，你就能邊問邊檢查，買得安心又明白！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a glowing dashboard warning light

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This silver sedan looks nice. What's the mileage?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈsɪvəl ˈsedən lʊks naɪs wʌts ðə ˈmaɪlɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 這台銀色轎車看起來不錯。里程數多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty-two thousand, and one owner before you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti tu ˈθaʊzənd ənd wʌn ˈoʊnər bɪˈfɔr ju/
dialogue.zh: 六萬兩千，前面只有一位車主。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not bad. Has it been in any accidents?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt bæd hæz ɪt bɪn ɪn ˈænidʒənts/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No reports at all. Want me to print it out?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rɪˈpɔrts ət ɔl wɑnt mi tə prɪnt ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒有紀錄。要我列印出來給你看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. Can we take it for a drive?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliːz kæn wi teɪk ɪt fɔr ə draɪv/
dialogue.zh: 好，麻煩了。我們可以試開一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Do you have your license on you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli du ju hæv jɔr ˈlaɪsəns ɑn ju/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。你有隨身帶駕照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right here. Hmm, the brakes feel a bit soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɪr hʌm ðə breɪks fil ə bɪt sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 就在這兒。嗯，煞車踩起來有點軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pads are about fifty percent, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pædz ɑr əˈbaʊt ˈfɪfti pərˈsɛnt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，煞車片大約還有五成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. And that light on the dash, is it normal?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd ðæt laɪt ɑn ðə dæ ɪz ɪt ˈnɔrməl/
dialogue.zh: 好。那儀表板上亮著的燈，是正常的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the check engine light. It needs work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə tʃɛk ˈɛndʒɪn laɪt ɪt nidz wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 那是檢查引擎的指示燈，需要處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that changes the price for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt ˈtʃeɪndʒiz ðə praɪs fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那價格對我就要變了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair. We can knock eight hundred off today.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr wi kæn nɑk eɪt ˈhʌndrəd ɔf təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 合理。今天我們可以減掉八百塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, but I'd like my own mechanic to check it.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks bʌt aɪd laɪk maɪ oʊn ˌmɛkəˈnɪs tə tʃɛk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，不過我想請我自己的技師檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, most people ask for that pre-purchase check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr moʊst ˈpipəl æsk fɔr ðæt pri ˈpɜrtʃəs tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，多數人買前都會要求檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Can I leave it here overnight, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt kæn aɪ liv ɪt hɪr ˌoʊvərˈnaɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那我今晚可以把車留在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll hold it until tomorrow at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪl hoʊld ɪt ənˈtɪl təˈmɑroʊ æt faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我會幫你保留到明天五點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll bring the report back with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪl brɪŋ ðə rɪˈpɔrt bæk wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我會把檢查報告帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keys are at the front desk then. Deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /kiz ɑr æt ðə frʌnt dɛsk ðɛn dil/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙就在櫃台那邊，說定了？
